rules.statement: At the No-Tell Motel at the end of the Konpeki Plaza job, Dex DeShawn shot V.
rules.notes: Not a branch but an unconditional beat of The Heist. Scene q005_15_no_tell_motel (ah5-02 batch) is a single conversation with Dex at the motel whose last beat is Dex's betrayal: Dex says V's name-style lines then V reacts 'Dex, what the fuck?!' / choice 'The fuck are you doing?!' | 'I'll fucking kill you!' (nodes 872, 873, 880, 958); every dialogue path ends in the shooting, only wording differs (q005_lie_relic, q005_dex_loop_end). Phase q005_09_no_tell_motel runs scene (node 37) -> journal q005_heist succeeded (45) -> q005_active=0 (82) -> q005_done=1 exact (65), so q005_done is written only after the motel scene completes. q005_done is also written by history-init/standalone phases (mq055, ep1 start, mq048, tests), so the rule is guarded by jt.heist.briefing (journal participate_briefing, only exists in a real play-through). Saves: q005_done=1 in all 8 playthroughs; journal q005_heist/return/talk_dex succeeded in the 6 full-play playthroughs and absent in the two history-init ones (653599, 65df79) where q005_done is 1 but the briefing journal is not set. Statement says only that Dex shot V, nothing about the aftermath.

Unverified candidate, not executable. Topic conflict: the fact is set in 99 saves and is 1 together with the mapped choice_02_done in 96, so this row and ah5.corpo-rat.frank-chat (same topic) would suppress each other on the common branch; it needs its own topic and an alias for both rules. Scene q000_corpo_02_to_elevators (ah5-04). The only writer of q000_corpo_02_cut_short (node 433, graph[35], =1 exact) is reached only from the player options 'I'm in a rush.' (choice 12 option 1) and 'I need to run.' (choice 61 option 3), after which Frank says 'Listen, sorry, uh, in a bit of a rush right now? We'll talk another time' (node 59). history-init phases do not write it (they write choice_02_done only). Caveat: q000_corpo_02_choice_02_done (used by the mapped frank-chat rule) is set by the And node 1636 after ANY of the three topic questions (Cape Town, Jenkins, boss), so a V who asked one topic and then said 'I need to run' has both facts; the mapped 'completed' rule can therefore co-fire with this one. 03a_talk_friend succeeds on both paths (prior review), kept only as a stage guard.

candidate.statement: In the Arasaka lobby V told Frank Nostra they were in a rush, and the reunion chat was cut short.
candidate.liveCheck: No live check is needed for the fact. Build step: give the row its own native topic (compatible-facet) and alias the existing ah5.corpo-rat.frank-chat rule too (an aliased decision requires every rule of the decision to be aliased), then regenerate the lane.

rules.notes: Unverified candidate, not executable. mq041_var_frank_sofa is set in only 1 save, and the end state behind the sofa workspot is unread, so it is unproven that "stood down alive" is right rather than another calm end. Scene mq041_corpo_02_confrontation (ah5-02). V's persuasion line 'It's a closed book, Frank. Gotta refigure your life. Game over, start again.' (node 204; reached from 'Open your eyes' node 191 or 'Gotta start over' choice 55 option 1) fans out to: EquipItem (768), SetAttitudeGroup friendly for Frank (687), MovePuppet + two workspots (247, 359, 1226) and SetVar mq041_var_frank_sofa=1 exact (438) then the quest-entry updates, Johnny's closing lines and End. Combat branches (V's 'I kill you right here and now', 'Go ahead, try') never pass node 204 and write no fact. So frank_sofa>=1 is a positive, exclusive 'talked down, attitude friendly' marker. It does NOT distinguish suicide from walking away: the catalog outcomes are walked-away / self-inflicted-death, and the scripted workspot content (sofa) could not be read from the graph, so the outcome key walked-away is the closest fit, not an exact one. No fact exists for killed / incapacitated / suicide (all use killed|defeated|unconscious community conditions).

candidate.statement: In the War Pigs confrontation V talked Frank Nostra down and he stood down, ending the standoff without a fight.
candidate.liveCheck: At the War Pigs confrontation pick "Gotta start over" (the talk-down line), watch what Frank does (sits and stays alive, or shoots himself), then read mq041_var_frank_sofa in the CET console: print(Game.GetQuestsSystem():GetFactStr("mq041_var_frank_sofa")) (expect 1; 0 on the fight branches). If Frank dies on the sofa, reword to the self-inflicted-death outcome.

rules.notes: Unverified candidate, not executable. q005_01_evelyn_fluff and q005_01_dex_knows are both set in 3 saves, so the options are not exclusive and the row would conflict with the shipped disclosed rule; it also covers only one of the two withholding paths. Scene q005_01_plan (priority-jackie-takemura batch). q005_01_evelyn_fluff=1 exact (node 3428, graph[96]) is written ONLY by option 2 'Something's off about her.' of choice 3385, itself reachable only after option 0 'Pretty well. Saw Konpeki Plaza from the inside.' of choice 3545 (sceneview confirms both are exclusive). The disclosure fact q005_01_dex_knows (node 3387) is written only via 3545 option 1 or 3385 option 1, so evelyn_fluff and dex_knows cannot both be set in one pass (3385 is a one-shot choice). This is only the 'withheld but hinted' half of 'withheld': V who answers 'That's it. Let's go over the plan.' withholds with no fact at all, so absence stays a non-signal. Statement is limited to what V said.

candidate.statement: In the briefing with Dex and Jackie, V told Dex that something felt off about Evelyn Parker.
candidate.liveCheck: No live check is needed for the conflict. Do not promote as "withheld". If wanted, make it its own facet (native topic with a compatible-facet alias: "V also said something felt off about Evelyn") and keep the disclosed rule.

rules.statement: At the Dashi parade V spared the defeated Oda instead of killing him.
rules.notes: Scene q112_08_parade_speech (priority-jackie-takemura batch). q112_08_oda_spared=1 (node 372, graph[42]) is written only through the single-option choice 43 'It's your lucky day today...' which is offered while Oda is down but not killed (condition 366 killed>=1 false; Takemura on the holocall: 'Do not kill him'). The kill path writes q112_oda_dead (node 341, already used by jt.oda-fate.killed) and V's 'I'm sorry, Oda.' instead. Same speaker/guard convention as the mapped jt.oda-fate.killed (takemura, participant, guarded by jt.parade.oda-defeated). Hanako is not on that call and is left out. Offline check 2026-10-15 (decision_rows_offline_check.mjs, 110 real saves): the earlier "never set in any save" was an artefact of the fact dictionary, which does not index scene-written facts. q112_08_oda_spared is 1 in 71 saves (the long corporate run, parade objective succeeded, q112_oda_dead absent) and 0 in the 8 other saves that passed the Oda fight, 2 of which have q112_oda_dead=1; the two facts are never both set (0 of 110) and neither is set in 6 saves that passed the fight, so the mercy prompt can be skipped and absence is not claimed. 70 of the 71 saves are one run; other runs show the dead branch and the skipped prompt.

rules.statement: Royce went down under the Militech assault on All Foods while V and Jackie were there.
rules.notes: Scene q003_04d_shootout_militech (ah5-01). Node 301 writes q003_royce_dead=1 after node 298: CharacterKilled(#royce, killed OR defeated OR unconscious, entireCommunity=1). The other writers of q003_royce_dead are q003_03_deal node 8612 (only the 'Shoot Royce' option, i.e. q003_deal_royce_shoot, which cannot coexist with the Militech assault) and the royce_bossfight phase (hostile no_deal route, where Militech does not invade), so militech_invades>=1 AND royce_dead>=1 isolates the Militech-assault writer. The scene scripts the reaction (DumDum: 'They killed Royce!!!', Jackie: 'They got him! He's done!'). Real saves 65224c and 5fd173 (the only militech_invades=1 playthroughs) both have royce_dead=1. Totentanz routing (sq011_nancy node 276) was checked and cannot serve as an alive marker (Royce is shown there unless dead AND dumdum dead AND combat AND no_deal). Offline check 2026-10-15: q003_militech_invades is set in exactly 4 saves and q003_royce_dead is set in all 4; royce_dead is also set in the 89 saves of the long run that fought Royce (boss fight, militech_invades absent) and in none of the saves where V never reached All Foods. q003_deal_royce_shoot and q003_militech_refused are never set together with militech_invades. The statement still says only that Royce went down.

Unverified candidate, not executable. The draft condition fires after rescues too; the exclusive signal is a journal entry not in the pack's allowlist (see newJournal), seen in only one save (65224c). DRAFT ONLY, THIS CONDITION IS NOT EXCLUSIVE: q003_brick_dead=1 is written by q003_05_transition node 1080 after the charge detonates, but q003_end node 325 also writes q003_brick_dead=1 whenever q003_brick_saved>0, so the fact is also 1 after a rescue (saves 683244, 64a0c3, 653802 have both facts =1). The real discriminator found in the 9 playthroughs is a journal objective: quests/main_quest/prologue/q003_maelstrom/03_escape/15_talk_to_brick5 is failed only in save 65224c (brick_dead=1, brick_saved absent) and succeeded in the three rescue saves, which also have 15_talk_to_brick2 succeeded (absent in 65224c). Needs the 15_talk_to_brick5 journal entry in the pack and more than one dead-Brick save before it can be a rule.

candidate.statement: Brick was killed when the mine he was rigged to went off in the All Foods factory while V and Jackie were there.
candidate.liveCheck: Build step first: add the objective quests/main_quest/prologue/q003_maelstrom/03_escape/15_talk_to_brick5 (gameJournalQuestObjective, in the cooked journal) to the journal allowlist with a hash-bound cooked-journal pointer, then the condition is q003_brick_dead >= 1 and brick5 == failed. Live: let Brick die in the trap in a second run (one save exists) and confirm brick5 failed.

rules.statement: During the Big Pete job, V's confrontation with Pete ended in a fight and Pete was left dead or knocked out; Dakota's debrief was the one for that result.
rules.notes: Writer: sts_bls_ina_02_ow questphase node 14 sets ina_02_big_pete_dead=1 (hash-bound copy in sts_bls_inland_avenue). Its trigger (node 19) is questCharacterKilled on #ina_02_com_big_pete with killed=1, defeated=1, unconscious=1, so the fact means killed OR knocked out, not death alone; the statement says so. In sts_bls_ina_02_big_pete_scene Pete is alive and standing at the standoff; the three spare options (Deal / Fine but I don't want your money / Eddies now) set ina_02_big_pete_spared=1 and he walks away, while 'No can do' sets ina_02_bp_attack and starts the fight. So the dead fact belongs to the fight branch. Real saves: 65a9d8, 65224c, 5fd173 have dead=1 and spared never appears in any save. Dakota's debrief phone message (contacts/dakota_smith/sts_bls_ina_02/...) is selected by dead>0 in ow node 109. Remaining doubt: a V who shot Pete before talking could in theory also reach the scene; not seen in the graph. Not usable for paid/unpaid spare.

rules.statement: After the Aldecaldo initiation party, Panam sent V her friendly check-in messages about the chip and her plans, the friends version of her ending hook rather than the romantic one.
rules.notes: q114_msg_panam_ending_hook questphase node 1 branches on sq027_panam_lover>0: True side sends contacts/panam/q114_panam_ending_hook_lover/*, False side sends q114_panam_ending_hook_friendship/*, including 02_msg_panam_friend (pack key al5.panam.friendship-hook, already used as guard of al5.devil.called-platonic). sq027_panam_lover is written only in sq027_06_panzer (and test scenes) and is 1 in saves 683244, 64a0c3, 65224c; the friendship message is active in 65a9d8, 653802, 5fd173. The two sets of saves are disjoint. Caveat: the hook is sent for anyone who reaches q114 without the lover fact, including a V who skipped the Panam job, so the statement avoids claiming the Queen of the Highway job was completed. Offline check 2026-10-15: the friendship message is active in 6 saves, all with sq027_panam_lover absent; sq027_panam_lover=1 in 72 saves, none of which has the message; 32 saves have neither (the quest is not reached). Disjoint in every save. The row joins the topic aliases.

rules.statement: At the Aldecaldo camp party Benedict, whom V had extracted in the MIA job, was present among the guests.
rules.notes: q114_party questphase: node 152 reads ina_09_finished>0; True feeds a pause on #ina_09_com_ben being spawned and then the q114_04b_party scene input Benedict_In; False skips it. ina_09_finished is written in sts_bls_ina_09_openworld node 34 (MIA complete) and is 1 in saves 65a9d8, 65224c, 5fd173. The journal guard is the party objective talk_panam (pack key al5.initiation.party-talk-panam), which keeps the row from firing before the party stage; no save reaches the party objective, so that half of the guard is never observed. Statement keeps 'present' only and does not say anything Ben said or whether he was alone (ina_09_ben_left_alone exists in 5fd173).

Unverified candidate, not executable. The journal path is not in the pack allowlist, was never observed in any save, and the topic alias row cannot be edited in this lane. q103_14_maelstrom scene (scene-evidence/priority-panam-20261004-ghost-handoff) sends Rogue's contacts/rogue/q103/q103_clean_deal text only on the branch where q103_helped_panam is 0; q103_helped_panam is written by q103_11_tunnel_drive node 16 on the help choice. Positive signal exists but is a phone message not yet in the pack journal allowlist, and it is '-' in all 9 playthroughs (every real save helped Panam). The prior review also notes the decision's topic-alias domain blocks an exact catalog topic.

candidate.statement: After the Basilisk was recovered, V turned down Panam's push to pursue Nash further, and Rogue later sent V the message about the clean deal.
candidate.liveCheck: At q103_11_tunnel_drive do not help Panam. Expect q103_helped_panam=0 and the Rogue message contacts/rogue/q103/q103_clean_deal active in the phone journal. Needs that message in the journal allowlist before the row can run.

rules.notes: Unverified candidate, not executable. No positive marker that separates 'no van' from 'van delivered' or from 'Iris left alone'; the objective failure is not in the allowlist and was never observed in saves. sts_bls_ina_06_ow: node 276 sets opt_get_iris_car and park_car_in_garage to Failed on the False side of ina_06_car_delivered after ina_06_dakota_met>0. ina_06_car_delivered=1 is written only after the car arrives. The draft needs the failed state of the objective opt_get_iris_car (a new journal path) together with dakota_met; as written the two facts alone also match the delivered-with-van branch, so this draft cannot execute. ina_06_iris_hired and finished are also written on the ina_06_tanner_left_alone path (Iris abandoned), where Dakota's debrief says she was left high and dry, so that overlap would have to be separated too.

candidate.statement: V brought Iris Tanner to Dakota but Iris's van was not delivered with her, and Dakota's job closed with that result.
candidate.liveCheck: Nothing to build. Retire this row after checking cc5.iris.car-left live: fail or abandon the optional car objective, then expect the journal entry opt_get_iris_car failed and Iris/Dakota told the car was left.

rules.statement: After their dinner together in Following the River, V kissed River and the two became intimate.
rules.notes: Scene sq029_04a_dinner (scene-evidence rel-sq029-20261005). questSetVar sq029_river_had_sex=1 exact (node 1753, graph[154]) is the only writer (W1 across the quest index and all exported scenes). sceneview: the kiss choice (node 404) option 0 '[Kiss]' is the ONLY option leading to the write; option 1 'I can't, River. I'm sorry.' (caption nokiss) does not. The earlier chain also needs the 'Just don't fall in love...' (427) and 'I can see what you're doin'' (422) options, the other options there lead to just_friends. Saves: sq029_river_had_sex=1 in playthrough 5fd173 (3 of 3 saves). Overlap to flag for the reviewer: the existing jr-native.river-relationship-committed rule (sq029_river_lover from sq029_05_morning_after) is also true whenever this one is, because the morning scene is only reached after the kiss/sex branch, so the two outcomes of the same topic are both true after a committed morning; there is no positive marker for 'intimate but not committed'. The statement says only that intimacy occurred and does not mention commitment.

rules.statement: While cooking and eating together in Following the River, V asked River about his parents and River told V what had happened to them.
rules.notes: Scene sq029_02a_arrival (scene-evidence rel-sq029-20261005). questSetVar sq029_02_dark_story=1 exact (node 1140, graph[94]) is the only writer (W1). sceneview: choice node 1125 option 1 'Your parents - what happened?' (caption dark) is the ONLY option that reaches the write; option 0 'Hmm. Maybe not just now.' does not, so the fact is set only if V asked. Saves: 1 in playthrough 683244 (69 of 93 saves, set from the start of that scene onward). Caveat: choice node 926 'You don't have to go on...' sits upstream of the write, so V can still interrupt after the story has begun and the fact is already set; the statement therefore says River told V what happened and does not claim the full account was heard (the 'stopped' outcome cannot be separated and is a no-signal disposition).

rules.statement: For the MaxTac convoy job in Black Steel in the Hour of Chaos, V chose Sandra Dorsett as the netrunner to get convoy intelligence from.
rules.notes: Phase q305_01_task, Sandra sub-phase (path nodes/6/Data/phaseGraph/nodes/20): q305_01_netrunner_picked_Sandra=1 exact (nodes 20/20 and 20/24) and q305_got_netrunner=1 exact (node 20/26) are written only inside the Sandra branch, mirroring the Nix, Mr Hands and Chang branches; the netrunner choice is exclusive. Both facts are already [ALLOW] and used by phantom.priority.steel-intel-sandra (with the pph.steel-intel-sandra journal for Reed). q305_got_netrunner=1 in playthroughs 683244 (Nix branch) and 65224c (Mr Hands branch); q305_01_netrunner_picked_Sandra itself is never nonzero in the 110 saves (no real playthrough chose Sandra), so this rests on the pack's own use of the facts. Overlap to flag: the existing jr5.steel.sandra-contact.intel-delivered rule (journal jr5.steel.sandra-send-reed) is a later stage of the same topic and is also true whenever Sandra was chosen and delivered; there is no predicate for 'chosen but intel not yet delivered', so both outcomes will be true after delivery. Statement says only that V chose Sandra.

Unverified candidate, not executable. q305_sandra_task_accepted is absent in all 110 saves, I could not prove that every path out of the Sandra scene writes it only after the request has actually been spoken (the refusal branch of choice 23 was not traced to the end), and the outcome overlaps the mapped fulfilled-confirmed outcome. Scene q305_02e_sandra, questSetVar q305_sandra_task_accepted=1 exact (node 108, graph[25]; only writer W1; already [ALLOW] and used by phantom.priority.steel-sandra-task-accepted for Reed and Songbird as told-by-v). sceneview: choice 43 offers 'Sure, do it if I get the chance.', 'What if I refuse?', 'What's this virus do?' and 'Who you spyin' on MaxTac for?', and ALL of them reach node 108, as does option 0 of choice 23 and option 0 of choice 35; the 'Refuse' captioned option of choice 23 also appears to rejoin. So the fact means 'Sandra made her request' and not that V agreed; the statement therefore claims only that she asked. Overlap to flag: the existing jr5.steel.sandra-favor.fulfilled-confirmed (journal jr5.steel.sandra-thanks) is the terminal stage of the same exclusive topic; both outcomes are true after fulfilment (the prior reviewer's reason). Never nonzero in any of the 110 saves.

candidate.statement: When V met Sandra Dorsett about the MaxTac convoy, Sandra asked V to deploy a Trojan virus of hers during the job.
candidate.liveCheck: Pick Sandra as the netrunner, then in her scene try the option that refuses and one that accepts. Read q305_sandra_task_accepted after each (expect 1 after every path that reaches the request, which settles whether it means "asked" or "agreed").

rules.notes: Unverified candidate, not executable. sq021_v_has_2_choose is never nonzero in any save, so there is no real-save confirmation, and it is not proven that the fact is written only when V lacks the farm deduction (exclusivity with edgewood-deduced is unproven). Scene sq021_07_ride_back. Choice 502 option 0 '[Stand] Let's try Edgewood Farm.' (caption Farm1) is the ONLY option leading to sq021_good_farm_chosen=1 (node 615, graph[87]) in this scene; option 1 '[Stand] I vote Poppy Farm.' writes sq021_bad_farm_chosen (graph[12], pack jr5.hunt.location.poppy). sq021_good_farm_chosen is also written by other nodes: sq021_finale (twice) and sq029 (standalone/debug starts, two nodes), so it is only a valid signal together with the scene-local sq021_v_has_2_choose (non-exact, graph[137] in the same scene, only writer, reached on the two-farm vote). Saves: sq021_good_farm_chosen=1 in 683244, 65a9d8, 65224c, 5fd173 (all had sq021_v_knows_farm=1, i.e. the deduced route) and sq021_v_has_2_choose is absent in all of them, so the two-farm vote may be a rare path or the fact may not persist. The existing jr5.hunt.location.edgewood-deduced rule requires v_knows_farm; this row cannot exclude v_knows_farm without a zero test, so if V both deduced and was shown the vote the two outcomes would overlap. The statement avoids saying V lacked clues.

candidate.statement: In The Hunt, with the search narrowed to two farms, V voted to check Edgewood Farm first.
candidate.liveCheck: In The Hunt skip the deduction clues, reach the vote and pick "[Stand] Let's try Edgewood Farm". Expect sq021_v_has_2_choose=1, sq021_good_farm_chosen=1, sq021_v_knows_farm=0. Then repeat with the deduction to see whether v_has_2_choose can be 1 together with v_knows_farm.

Real save 683244 EndGameSave-2 has hideout S, 02_survive S, 05_confront_yorinobu S and q112_takemura_dead 0. Unverified candidate, not executable. q112_takemura_dead is 0 in every real save (no save of the Takemura-lost story), so the combination was never observed; Hanako's presence in the dead-Takemura variant was not read in the scene. q112_takemura_dead is [ALLOW] and already drives jt.takemura-fate.left-behind and ah5.estate.takemura-absent (set at q112_10_safe_house nodes 71/207, reset only on the rescue path). rules.statement: In Heaviest of Hearts V accepted Georgina's offer to anonymize Michael Maldonado's testimony instead of having it deleted.
rules.notes: Writer: sts_ep1_06_george scene (scene-evidence/pg5-04) graph[17] sets sts_ep1_06_testimony_agree=1, reached only through the line 'Fine, deal. Don't trust you, but that goes double for Mike.' which follows choice 1123 option 0 'Fine. We have a deal.' after Georgina says 'I'm offering to anonymize Michael's testimony'. The delete option ('I don't believe you. Delete the testimony.') writes sts_ep1_06_deal_refuse and testimony_withdrawn=1 instead, so the two branches are exclusive. The deal path then sets testimony_withdrawn=0 exact. Reads: the client scene shows option 1 'Georgina scrubbed your name from the testimony' only while withdrawn==0, and Hands' holocall debrief (sts_ep1_06_holocall_debrief graph[17], withdrawn==0 branch) opens 'I just got off the holo with Mr. Maldonado. He was most certainly not pleased', while the withdrawn==1 branch is the 'most satisfied' variant already used by pg5.hearts.deleted, so Hands does hear about this outcome. Offline check 2026-10-15: of the 51 saves with the quest succeeded, 47 have sts_ep1_06_testimony_agree=1 (with deal_refuse and testimony_withdrawn absent) and 4 have testimony_withdrawn=1 (with agree absent). Never both, never neither: the fact splits the finished saves exactly as the dialogue reading says, and the withdrawn side is the deleted rule pg5.hearts.deleted that already ships.

rules.statement: At El Coyote Cojo V stepped in when two gangers tried to rob Pepe Najarro and talked them into walking away from him.
rules.notes: Scene mq040_01_bar (hash-bound export, heywood batch). The only writer of mq040_gangers_scene_done is node 919 (graph[155], =1 exact). The ganger confrontation is choice node 18 with five options: opt0 'Go ahead. Make my day.' (Confront) and opt1 (Bad Blood) lead into the fight lines (n20, n28); opt2 'Don't even start with me.' (Solo) and opt3 'Mama Welles doesn't like fights.' (Street Kid) lead to the ganger's backing-off line ('Not worth it'), after which node 919 fires; opt4 'Fine. Do what you want.' (Back off) goes elsewhere. The upstream walk shows node 919 reachable only from options 2 and 3 of choice 18 (the single-option intro choice 462 'Lay off him.' sits upstream of all of them). Only one writer exists (W1), no history-init or standalone phase writes it. Saves: 64a0c3 has mq040_gangers_scene_done=1 with the quest succeeded and journal 02_fight (pack key hw5.pepe.bar-fight) absent; the other three play-throughs that completed the quest (683244, 65a9d8, 5fd173) have 02_fight succeeded and the fact absent. The statement says only that V talked the two gangers down, which covers both talk-down options. It does not say anything about the later marriage advice.

Unverified candidate, not executable. The only exclusive signal is journal contacts/lizzy_wizzy/mq019_05_no_job/01_lizzy_msg_no_reward, which is not in the pack allowlist and never appears in any of the 110 saves; the fact draft in condition also fires after the disposal route. DRAFT ONLY, THIS CONDITION IS NOT EXCLUSIVE: mq019_done=1 (written by the finale phase after both routes) is also true after V agreed and moved the body. The real discriminator is a phone message that exists only on the refusal route. Phase mq019_06_finale (authenticated-oct01 export): scene node 7 'out_completed' goes to the move-body phase (node 23: 04_move_body, which sets mq019_liam_disposed on success or mq019_liam_disposed_failed=1 on a failed move) while the scene's 'out_failed' goes straight to the quest Succeeded node 47 -> 26 -> condition node 45 'mq019_liam_disposed_failed > 0'. When that fact is 0 (V never started the disposal) the False branch fires journal node 28, phone message contacts/lizzy_wizzy/mq019_05_no_job/01_lizzy_msg_no_reward; the True branch (a started-then-failed disposal) does not send it. So that message is active only when V refused in the scene. In all 9 playthroughs the message and its conversation are absent: the four saves that reached the finale (683244, 65a9d8, 65224c, 653802) all moved the body (04_move_body succeeded) and 64a0c3 never reached the finale. No real save of the refusal route exists, and the message is not in the pack journalAllowlist.

rules.notes: Unverified candidate, not executable. mq028_aborted is never nonzero in any of the 110 saves (all three playthroughs that ran the quest completed it), is not in the pack factAllowlist, and the three writers have no player choice, so the cause on V's side (left versus compromised) is not established. Scene mq028_02_park (hash-bound export, city-contacts batch). mq028_aborted has exactly three writers, all =1 and all directly after Blue Moon quits on screen: node 1267 (graph[161]) after her line that it is a waste of time and she is calling it a day (reached after the 03_defeat journal entry), node 1272 (graph[162], exact) after her line that this is pointless and she is going home (right after 02_watch), and node 1278 (graph[163]) after her line that V is not taking this seriously and she is going home. None of the three sits behind a player choice, so the fact marks the abort itself, not which V action caused it (waiting too long, leaving the area, or provoking the scene). Not written by any history-init phase. The fact has two readers, both inside the same scene. The root quest mq028 Failed state is shared with Blue Moon being killed or knocked out (prior review), so the quest state is not used.
